name: Erlebnistherme Zillertal
kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen: 34 °C heated thermal brine pool, 133 m Black Hole water slide, and a newly redesigned sauna village with panoramic mountain views.
oeffnungszeiten: Therme täglich 10:00–22:00 Uhr, Sauna täglich 13:00–22:00 Uhr
beschreibung:
Overview

The Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen is the premier year-round bathing and wellness resort in the front Zillertal valley. Nestled in the sunny valley floor with unobstructed views of the Spieljoch hiking and skiing area, this modern facility pairs thrilling water fun for families with deep regeneration for wellness seekers. Over 1,000 m² of covered water surface, spectacular adventure slides, a therapeutic outdoor thermal brine pool, and a sauna and wellness area comprehensively modernized in 2024 for over 13 million euros make the thermal baths an ideal all-weather destination for locals and visitors alike.

Water Worlds & Sauna Village

Inaugurated in December 2006, the thermal spa has set benchmarks in Tyrolean aquatic tourism ever since. The vibrant centerpiece is the large adventure wave pool with a current channel, geysers, bubble grotto, and waterfall. Adrenaline lovers flock to the 133-metre-long Black-Hole-Röhrenrutsche – the longest adventure slide in Western Austria, equipped with dazzling light effects, sound, and timekeeping – as well as the 134-metre tyre slide Red Tube. Younger guests delight in the dedicated children's water world Zillantis with age-appropriate play areas. Those seeking relaxation appreciate the year-round heated Thermalsolebecken outdoors: at a soothing water temperature of 34 °C and a salt content of two percent, the body unwinds under an atmospheric illuminated glass dome. The spacious sauna complex (Adults Only, ages 15+) features a stone pine sauna, organic herb sauna, Finnish infusion rituals, steam baths, and a 258 m² panoramic terrace overlooking the Zillertaler Bergwelt. In summer, the 1,700 m² outdoor swimming pool with its 5,000 m² sunbathing lawn offers additional refreshment.

Visit & Getting There

The thermal baths are open daily from 10:00 to 22:00; the sauna and spa area welcomes guests daily from 13:00 to 22:00 (in summer, the outdoor pool opens on swimming days from 09:00 to 19:00). Bathing admission prices (as of 2025/2026 for a 3-hour ticket): adults approx. €19.00, youth (ages 15–17) €17.40, children (ages 6–14) €16.30, children under 6 free; adult day pass approx. €34.20. Access to the sauna world requires a moderate surcharge of approx. €8.00 to €10.00. Public transport: ÖBB train to Jenbach station, transfer to the Zillertalbahn (train or bus line 8330) to the Bahnhof Fügen-Hart stop; from there it is approx. a 10-minute walk or take the local bus directly to the Erlebnistherme stop. By car: Inntalautobahn A12, exit Wiesing/Zillertal, B169 to the Fügen Süd exit; spacious free parking is available at Badweg 1.

Tips

The entire complex is designed to be fully barrier-free: step-free entrances, elevators to all levels, accessible changing rooms and showers, and a mobile pool hoist ensure comfortable water access for guests with reduced mobility. On rainy holiday days, the thermal spa can get very busy from midday onwards – visit in the morning from 10:00 or take advantage of discounted evening rates after 18:00 to avoid queues.
